name: ActiveTickets Client
description: SOAP client and service for the ACTIVE Network ActiveTickets ticketing/events API.
project_description: ActiveTickets Client is a developer-facing integration layer for the ACTIVE Network "ActiveTickets" ticketing and events platform. It exposes a single injectable SOAP client service that wraps the ActiveTickets SOAP/WSDL web service, so other custom or contrib code can fetch programs (events/shows), genres, subgenres, locations, characteristics, routes and passes, and can read or mutate visitor (customer) records, interests, characteristics, order history and newsletter/login-key data. The module ships no entities, permissions, blocks, controllers, Drush commands or UI beyond one admin settings form; it is a service you inject and call from your own code. The SOAP endpoint requires an ext-soap PHP extension. Configure it at /admin/config/system/activetickets_client by entering the public and member WSDL URLs, the client name, the language code, an optional ticket URL and the ActiveTickets API token (sent as the x-api-key request header). Two services are registered: activetickets_client.client (public methods) and activetickets_client.member_client (bound to the member WSDL). Results are returned as PHP arrays parsed from the SOAP XML; getCachedProgramList() adds a default-cache-backed program list. This module requires the ext-soap PHP extension.
